Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 126. Category: technique. Rank 2.

Rank 2 melee technique
Ki Cost: 10 ki
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Self
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Upkeep
The user grows an additional set of arms to take an
enhanced fighting stance. For the duration of this
technique The damage die for your unarmed strikes and
melee techniques have their damage die increased by
one step and you gain +2 to strength ability checks and
saving throws.
(1d4>1d6>1d8>1d10>1d12>2d6,> etc)
